guitar.modelsText: ESP Explorer-style / ESP KH models / Gibson Explorer
guitar.evidence: James Hetfield's ESP Explorer-style "Iron Cross" guitars and Kirk Hammett's ESP KH signature models (and earlier Jackson/Gibson Flying V/Explorer use) are extensively documented.

tone.target: clean acoustic-like arpeggios with wide stereo delay and light chorus
tone.profile: clean acoustic-like arpeggios with wide stereo delay and light chorus
tone.summary: A pristine signal chain featuring compression for warmth, a US Deluxe amp model paired with the US 2x12 cab, enhanced by Chorus and Digital Delay to achieve wide, acoustic-like arpeggios.
